limits: The main grapes together: at least 50%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation whose wine is made from Gamay and Chardonnay, with Pinot Noir as a minor grape. It covers more than fifty communes, including Aubière, Boudes and Châteaugay.
